title: Current evidence and remaining commissioning requirements
summary: Source v0.4 and sphere v0.1 are present on GitHub main as of 27 October, without matching Autobuild receipts in the inspected receipt paths. The new v0.4.2 stage-publisher branch contains 18 declared website tests, but independent tests requested over Rasen Falcon MCP have NOT_RUN pending owner approval.
invariants: Reported website preview tests 9/9 and delivery security-contract tests 13/13 are not TLS handshake evidence.
Receiver acceptance must be verified from its receipt; a ready.json marker is only submission.
CMS/Wire publisher, live HTTPS SNI, mTLS negative tests, LDAP, SMTP/IMAP, terminal and MCP integration all require real service tests.
No production cutover without distinct operator approval; source submission does not install keys or change hosts.
Never mark fixture-only results LIVE_PASS; missing credentials and deployment facts are NOT_RUN.
Do not label the 18 declared v0.4.2 website tests PASS until a tester returns command output and return codes; latest MCP reply was NOT_RUN.
The native NoSQLServer v0.90 candidate in Publisher v0.4 remains separate from its offline HTML/editor tests and is not a multi-writer approved CMS.

provenance.claim: Submitted candidate explicitly disclaims deployment and acceptance.
